about: Shared cases for round 39, written by the browser simulation. The Windows app must give the same words.
label: Also list my to-do items due next week
hint: From Thursday noon to Sunday, Today lists your unfinished to-do items due next week, from both lists, by title. They are read from this PC each time Today shows next week and only shown on the screen; nothing is kept or sent for them.
off: No ANDA dates of yours fall due next week. Your to-do items are not listed here; that is switched off in Settings.

weekRead.title: NEXT WEEK · MON NOV 30 TO FRI DEC 4
weekRead.empty: Nothing of yours falls due next week.

weekOff.title: NEXT WEEK · MON NOV 30 TO FRI DEC 4
weekOff.empty: No ANDA dates of yours fall due next week. Your to-do items are not listed here; that is switched off in Settings.

items: Settings has a second switch beside “Since you last looked”: whether next week in Today also lists your to-do items. Off, it reads neither to-do list for Today and shows no titles.
